verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's developer portal and AI Hub offer SDKs (AI Engine Direct SDK, GenieX toolkit) and model-deployment tooling that let developers programmatically target the Hexagon NPU, which is the closest analog to an 'API' for this hardware product. However, there is no formal public API specification (openapi.json, llms.txt probes all 404) and no detailed reference docs beyond marketing-style toolkit descriptions. missing for 10: a documented REST/SDK API reference with endpoints or function signatures, machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/llms.txt), and independent developer corroboration of using it.
